## RatifierUtils.isEip7702Designator() function

Checks whether bytecode is an EIP-7702 designator.

EIP-7702 accounts have code-like bytecode but still sign as the owning EOA, so they use the Ecrecover ratifier route instead of the Setter route.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function isEip7702Designator(bytecode: Hex): boolean;
```
